patch_list: Stops WeDJ's Mobylog tracking client from uploading playback, device-connection and startup app-check events.

Makes WeDJ treat the "Unlock Unlimited Playback" in-app purchase as owned. The free-version limit that stops playback after loading a few tracks is removed and the purchase entry disappears from the track browser. Use WeDJ 1.1.1.3 on Andro…
